description: an old man elder druid with a long white beard and long white hair, a wooden crown with two large branching brown antlers hung with green leaves and vines, shoulder armour of bark and leaves, a long green robe with golden-green patterns and a brown leather belt, a long mantle of orange and golden autumn leaves hanging behind from the shoulders, brown boots, no staff and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the antlers to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy
